title: MCLib addon entry
description: One file per addon in addons/<name>.json. tools/build_index.py validates these and builds index.json.

name.description: Unique name, used in `mcpanel mclib mclib install <name>`. Must match the file name.

project.description: The addon's repository. Only GitHub and Codeberg are allowed; versions are pulled from its releases.

products.description: Which MCPanel product(s) the addon is for: MCPanel-CLI, the MCPanel desktop app, MCPanel-WebUI. Every addon is installed into and runs inside MCPanel-CLI.
